summary: Add a reproducible local performance baseline, bounded single-PDF page concurrency, adjacent evidence extraction batches, and deterministic material/QA quality checks without adding dependencies or parallel paid requests.
decision_refs: User-selected P0 optimization list and ponytail instruction on 2026-09-15
approval_evidence: The user explicitly selected the four listed P0 updates and requested implementation with ponytail minimalism.
known_limitations: The measured 48-page benchmark is generated and reproducible because the two earlier customer PDFs were no longer present; it is not a customer-document or accuracy benchmark.
Paid model calls remain serial; batching reduces request count but does not prove model quality or live-provider speedup.
Page workers use process startup and separate OCR engines, so small PDFs may be slower with two or four workers.
Deterministic checks target clear false positives and evidence-scope errors; full entity, option and QA ontology mapping remains planned.
